about: A note's first line and what its title reads, blanks and fills aside (docs/DESIGN.md §145, 8): core/blanks.ts `titleWords`, then core/noteTitle.ts. `words` is the line after titleWords, `title` what noteTitle answers for a note that is only that line. The Rust namer's `title_of` is to read the same rows when its rule lands in a binary.

rows.words: how long to boil an egg
rows.title: how long to boil an egg
